ResearchTabDef.label: Vehicles
ResearchTabDef.generalDescription: Development and mass production of military ground vehicles, specialized chassis, engines, armor plates, and heavy armament from early 20th century prototypes to modern third-generation MBTs and combat aviation.

ResearchProjectDef.label: early motorization
ResearchProjectDef.description: First steps towards colony mechanization: bicycles, motorcycles, motorized aerosleds, and light machinegun-armed scout armored cars, as well as basic 45mm tank guns.

ResearchProjectDef.label: WWII light and medium armor
ResearchProjectDef.description: Design of maneuverable light tanks (BT-5, T-70) and classic medium battle tanks (T-28, T-34). Unlocks mass production of 57mm, 76.2mm, and 85mm tank guns and appropriate ammunition.

ResearchProjectDef.label: WWII heavy breakthrough armor
ResearchProjectDef.description: Heavy breakthrough tanks IS-2 and IS-3 with thick anti-shell armor, alongside the legendary BM-13 Katyusha multiple launch rocket system. Unlocks 122mm tank ammunition and 132mm M-13 rockets.

ResearchProjectDef.label: modern IFVs and light armor
ResearchProjectDef.description: Modern infantry fighting vehicles (BMP-3, M2A3 Bradley, Boomerang, Kurganets-25), BMPT Terminator, military logistic trucks, and MRAP armored cars (Kamaz-5350, Oshkosh M-ATV, Typhoon-VDV). Unlocks 25mm, 30mm, 57mm autocannons and basic ATGMs.

ResearchProjectDef.label: main battle tanks
ResearchProjectDef.description: Production of third-generation main battle tanks: M1A2 Abrams SEP, T-80BVM, T-90M Proryv, and M10 Booker mobile gun system. Unlocks 120mm NATO and 125mm smoothbore guns, APFSDS darts, HEAT-MP shells, and gun-launched ATGMs.

ResearchProjectDef.label: next-generation Armata platform
ResearchProjectDef.description: The pinnacle of modern armored warfare: next-gen T-14 Armata main battle tank with isolated crew capsule and unmanned digital turret, and T-15 Armata heavy IFV with advanced active protection systems.

ResearchProjectDef.label: tactical army aviation
ResearchProjectDef.description: Design and assembly of multirole tactical utility helicopters (UH-60 Black Hawk) for rapid troop insertion, combat extraction, and medical evacuation across the rimworld.

ResearchProjectDef.label: heavy military transport aviation
ResearchProjectDef.description: Heavy-lift assault cargo helicopters CH-53E Super Stallion and long-range tactical military transport aircraft C-130 Hercules.
